headline: A 1995 executive order by President Clinton dealing with how federal government corporations pay their employees.
what_it_does: This order concerns the pay and benefits practices of government corporations, which are federally owned businesses such as the Postal Service or Amtrak. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, reporting steps, or limits it sets cannot be confirmed from the title alone.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay and benefits practices are the subject of the order, though the exact effect is not described in the available material.
They may be directed to follow, review, or report on their compensation practices, but the details are not available.
